title: Vibrant LIfe
description: This texture pack project looks to make MInecraft more vissually vibrant by enhancing all the textures using a special proccess
body:
This texture pack makes minecraft more vibrant and specular using a special proccess. Warning results may vary because my proccess was entirely automated using the same values for every input texture. Also I tried to make sure i got everything but some textures might be missing. 
well i dont reall know if it will make the textures more vibrant and specular but it should since thats what i told the proccess to do.
